description: This file defines the ThingSearchSignalMapper class, which extends AbstractSignalMapper for handling signals related to 'thing search' commands such as start, request, and cancel stream within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages topic path construction, supported actions, and payload enhancement specific to search-related signals.

classes.name: ThingSearchSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractSignalMapper to handle mapping of signals related to 'thing search' commands, including determining topic paths and enhancing payloads based on command types.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the TopicPath for a given search command and channel.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TopicPathBuilder initialized with the namespace placeholder.

methods.name: getSupportedActions
methods.description: Returns an array of SearchAction enums indicating supported actions: REQUEST, CANCEL, SUBSCRIBE.

methods.name: setTopicPathAction
methods.description: Sets the appropriate action on the search topic path builder based on the command's name, supporting only predefined actions.

methods.name: unknownCommandException
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DittoRuntimeException for unknown command names.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action (subscribe, request, or cancel) on the search topic path builder based on the specified SearchAction.

methods.name: fromTopicPathBuilderWithChannel
methods.description: Creates a SearchTopicPathBuilder from a given TopicPathBuilder and channel, supporting only the TWIN channel.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the PayloadBuilder with data from the command, handling different command types (CreateSubscription, CancelSubscription, RequestFromSubscription) and building the JSON payload accordingly.
